intro.novel: The knowledge of the world, entry by entry: what the reader never reads but you need to know.
intro.game: The knowledge of the world, entry by entry: what the team needs to know, and what the player may discover.

codex.notFound: This entry is gone. It may be in the trash.
codex.moduleOff: The codex is off in this project: its entries stay saved and come back as soon as you turn it on again in the settings.

title.novel: The codex gathers the knowledge of the world: history, peoples, religions, magic, everything the reader never reads but you need to know.
title.game: The codex gathers the knowledge of the world: history, peoples, religions, magic, everything the team needs to know.

body.novel: What must stay consistent from the first chapter to the last? A date, a law, a legend. Write it here once and mention it with the at sign.
body.game: What does everyone working on the game need to know? A date, a law, a creature. Write it here once: the team finds it in the narrative design document.

empty.noCategories: Entries are grouped in categories: start from the suggested ones (history, peoples, religions, magic and technology, bestiary, languages, politics) or create your own.
empty.wayOut: Or create a category of your own first
